boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 71 packs a 6×8 grid with a large purple '13' block at the top, free-sliding smiley blocks in the middle, and directional arrow blocks on the sides. The purple block needs 13 exits — clear the bottom first, then work the smiley blocks, and finish with the heavy purple block at the top.
landmarks: Block Out Level 71 packs a 6×8 grid with a large purple '13' block at the top, free-sliding smiley blocks in the middle, and directional arrow blocks on the sides.
The purple block needs 13 exits — clear the bottom first, then work the smiley blocks, and finish with the heavy purple block at the top.
The board mixes Purple, Green, Yellow and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The purple '13' block is a marathon — clear the smiley blocks first to build space.
The smiley blocks in the middle are free-sliding — use this freedom to clear paths for the arrow blocks.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the green smiley blocks at the bottom through the bottom exit to open the base.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Shift the blue blocks on the left out through the left exit to open the lower-left area.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Begin sliding the yellow and green smiley blocks in the middle freely — they can move in any direction.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the red blocks on the right through the right exit as the middle opens.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Tackle the large purple '13' block at the top — it needs 13 exits to fully clear.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with any remaining smiley blocks trapped in the corners.

failurePoints: Trying to clear the '13' block before the smiley blocks — it needs room to slide and exit multiple times.
Clearing the top before the bottom, which leaves the lower blocks trapped with no sliding room.
